outputs.L2: The invention concerns integrated, modular display panels. In one implementation, a modular panel has a housing formed from a first heat-conductive material and a printed circuit board positioned within the housing. Multiple LEDs are mounted on a first surface of the circuit board, while a driver circuit located inside the housing is electrically connected to the LEDs through the board’s opposite surface. The panel also contains a power supply unit that provides power to the LEDs, with the printed circuit board situated between the LEDs and the power supply unit. A second heat-conductive material lies between the power supply unit and the panel’s exterior rear surface. In addition, a protective structure covers the first surface of the circuit board, making the panel’s display-facing side, which is opposite the exterior rear surface, waterproof.
outputs.L3:
The invention relates to integrated modular display panels, particularly display panels incorporating light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Each panel includes a thermally conductive shell that houses a printed circuit board. Multiple LEDs are mounted on a first side of the printed circuit board to form the display surface.

A driver circuit is also located within the shell and is electrically connected to the LEDs from a second, opposite side of the printed circuit board. The driver circuit controls the operation of the LEDs, while a power supply unit provides the electrical power required to illuminate them. The printed circuit board is positioned between the power supply unit and the LEDs, enabling a compact and integrated panel configuration.

The panel further includes thermal-management and protective structures. These structures conduct and dissipate heat generated by the electronic components toward the outer back side of the panel, thereby supporting reliable operation and extending component life. On the display side, protective sealing structures provide a waterproof barrier that shields the LEDs and internal electronics from moisture and environmental exposure. Together, these features provide a compact, durable, thermally efficient, and weather-resistant modular display panel.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to an integrated modular display panel designed to improve thermal performance, environmental protection, durability, and overall operating reliability. The panel includes a thermally conductive shell that supports and encloses the principal electronic components. A printed circuit board carrying an array of light-emitting diodes is positioned within or against the shell, while a driver circuit and a power supply are integrated into the same modular assembly. This arrangement reduces the need for separate external housings and connections, thereby simplifying installation, maintenance, and replacement.

To manage the heat generated by the LEDs, driver circuit, and power supply, one or more thermally conductive materials are disposed between heat-generating components and the shell. These materials may fill gaps, increase the effective heat-transfer area, and establish a continuous thermal path from the electronic components to the outer structure of the panel. The shell consequently functions not only as a protective enclosure but also as a heat-dissipating member, allowing heat to be transferred away from sensitive components more efficiently. The integrated thermal design helps limit localized temperature increases, reduces thermal stress, and supports stable operation over extended periods.

The display-facing side of the panel is formed or sealed to resist the entry of water and moisture. Protective sealing materials, encapsulation layers, gaskets, or equivalent waterproof structures may be provided around the LED board and relevant connection regions. By protecting the display side from rain, humidity, dust, and other environmental contaminants, the panel is particularly suitable for outdoor displays and installations exposed to demanding operating conditions.

The modular construction enables multiple panels to be assembled into a larger display while allowing individual modules to be installed or serviced independently. Integrating the LED board, driver circuit, power supply, thermal-transfer materials, and conductive shell into a compact unit can reduce assembly complexity and improve structural consistency. As a result, the invention provides a display panel with efficient heat dissipation, enhanced waterproof performance, improved durability, and greater long-term reliability.
outputs.L5:
## The Evolution and Embodiments of LEDs

LEDs, or light-emitting diodes, have transformed how people illuminate homes, offices, vehicles, and public spaces. Unlike traditional incandescent bulbs, LEDs convert electricity into light with minimal energy loss. This makes them efficient, durable, and suitable for a wide range of applications.

The many embodiments of LED technology demonstrate its versatility. LEDs can appear as individual indicator lights, flexible strips, compact bulbs, digital displays, automotive headlights, or large architectural lighting systems. Smart embodiments may also include wireless controls, adjustable colors, motion sensors, and automated brightness settings.

The continued development of LEDs has improved color quality, reduced manufacturing costs, and expanded design possibilities. Modern systems can create warm, comfortable illumination or vivid colors for entertainment and advertising. Specialized LEDs are also used in medical equipment, horticulture, communications, and industrial processes.

As sustainability becomes increasingly important, LEDs offer an effective way to lower electricity consumption and reduce maintenance needs. Their long service life and adaptable design ensure that LED technology will remain central to future lighting innovations.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract describing an integrated modular LED display panel with a thermally conductive shell, PCB, LED array, driver circuit, power supply, heat-dissipating material, and waterproof display side.
counterfactuals.output: An integrated modular light-emitting diode (LED) display panel includes a thermally conductive shell defining a display side and an interior cavity. A printed circuit board is disposed within the cavity and supports an array of LEDs arranged to emit light through the display side. A driver circuit is electrically coupled to the LED array and configured to control operation of the LEDs. A power supply is integrated within the shell and electrically connected to the driver circuit and the LED array. A heat-dissipating material is thermally coupled to one or more of the printed circuit board, driver circuit, power supply, and shell to transfer heat generated during operation to the shell for dissipation. The display side includes a waterproof structure comprising a transparent or translucent protective layer and one or more seals configured to inhibit ingress of water into the interior cavity. The panel further includes modular electrical and mechanical interfaces enabling multiple panels to be interconnected to form a larger display assembly.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a concise technical summary of an invention for a modular display panel that integrates LEDs, driver electronics, a power supply, thermal management components, and front-side waterproofing.
counterfactuals.output: A modular display panel combines an LED array, driver electronics, and a power supply within a self-contained housing. A thermally conductive structure transfers heat from the LEDs and electronic components to integrated heat-dissipation elements, improving operating efficiency and service life. The front side is sealed using transparent encapsulation, gaskets, or coated interfaces to prevent water ingress while preserving light output and image quality. counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a patent specification paragraph beginning with “Embodiments of the present invention relate to…” for an integrated LED panel whose PCB sits between the LEDs and power supply.
counterfactuals.output: Embodiments of the present invention relate to an integrated light-emitting diode (LED) panel comprising an array of LEDs, a power supply, and a printed circuit board (PCB) disposed between the array of LEDs and the power supply. The PCB may mechanically support the LEDs and include conductive traces, control circuitry, power-conditioning components, and electrical interconnections configured to distribute regulated power from the power supply to the LEDs. In certain embodiments, the PCB and associated panel structure provide electrical isolation, thermal management, and a compact stacked arrangement in which the LEDs are positioned on a light-emitting side of the PCB and the power supply is positioned on an opposing side. The integrated configuration may reduce wiring, panel thickness, assembly complexity, and manufacturing cost while improving reliability, heat dissipation, and uniformity of illumination.

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe one embodiment of a weather-resistant modular LED display panel, including the relative placement of the shell, printed circuit board, LEDs, driver circuit, power supply, protective front structure, and thermally conductive materials.
counterfactuals.output:
One embodiment comprises a shallow, weather-resistant shell having an open front and a closed rear wall. A printed circuit board is mounted inside the shell substantially parallel to the rear wall. An array of LEDs is secured to the front-facing side of the board so that the LEDs project toward the open front. LED driver circuitry is located on the board, preferably on its rear-facing side, while a sealed power supply is positioned behind or adjacent to the board within the shell and electrically connected to the driver circuitry.

A protective front structure, such as a transparent or translucent cover combined with a louvered mask or impact-resistant grid, is attached across the open front of the shell. A perimeter gasket seals the front structure to the shell, while sealed cable glands, conformal coatings, and potted connectors inhibit entry of rain and moisture.

Thermally conductive materials are placed between heat-producing components and the shell. For example, thermal pads or a thermally conductive potting compound couple the rear of the printed circuit board, driver components, and power supply to an aluminum heat spreader or directly to the shell’s rear wall. The shell may include external fins, allowing heat to pass from the LEDs, driver circuit, and power supply through the conductive materials and shell to the outside air while the electrical components remain protected from weather. Mechanical and electrical connectors along the shell edges permit multiple panels to be joined into a larger modular display.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Create an invention abstract for an all-in-one modular electronic display panel featuring rear heat transfer, an enclosed power supply, PCB-mounted LEDs, and a waterproof viewing surface.
counterfactuals.output:
**Abstract**

An all-in-one modular electronic display panel includes a housing, one or more printed circuit boards carrying an array of light-emitting diodes, an enclosed power supply, and a waterproof viewing surface positioned over the light-emitting array. Heat generated by the LEDs, driver circuitry, and power supply is transferred toward a rear portion of the housing through thermally conductive supports, heat spreaders, and/or a rear heat-dissipation structure, thereby reducing heat accumulation at the viewing surface. The power supply and associated control electronics are enclosed within the panel housing and electrically coupled to the printed circuit boards to provide a self-contained display module. Peripheral seals, gaskets, bonded layers, or encapsulants protect the viewing surface and internal components from water and environmental contaminants. Mechanical and electrical interfaces enable multiple panels to be detachably connected and arranged into larger display assemblies while maintaining alignment, weather resistance, power distribution, signal communication, and rearward thermal management.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
